consequence.statement: Netkit is an optional new datapath mode and veth remains the default, so an operator who does nothing sees no change. Switching an existing deployment from veth to netkit cannot be done in place.

original.statement: Cilium 1.16 adds netkit as a new, opt-in datapath mode for Linux kernels 6.8 or newer; veth remains the default and veth cannot be replaced by netkit in place.

decision.reason: [ev-5ba316aaead4] says netkit is a new, optional datapath mode and that Cilium still uses veth devices by default. An operator who does nothing therefore sees no change, so "none" (informational) fits. The note that veth cannot be swapped for netkit in place only matters to operators who choose to adopt netkit. It is not a required step for anyone who does nothing.
